title: Customer request sieve and prioritization for PII remediation, retention, and audit export workflows
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Define an operational "sieve" and scoring system to triage inbound customer requests related to log redaction, retention changes, PII remediation, and audit exports. Objective: enable deterministic prioritization that balances regulatory urgency, customer SLA tier, engineering effort, and risk exposure so PM/SE/Support can respond with clear timelines and next steps.
acceptance_criteria:
- Intake form fields capture regulatory driver, affected data types, affected customers/tenants, desired outcome (redact/retain/export), deadlines, and proof of need.
- Automatic scoring produces a triage category (Urgent / High / Normal / Low) and recommended route (Self-serve doc / SE assist / Escalate to Legal/Compliance / Engineering change).
- Hand-off templates and playbooks for each triage category exist and are linked in the Console triage dashboard.
- SLAs defined per category and customer tier; sample response and ETA language prepared for Support and Solutions Engineering.
implementation_notes:
- Build intake schema in Support intake form and webhook into triage queue.
- Add lightweight classifier to tag request types (PII, logs, exports, retention) and to flag likely regulatory drivers (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
- Scoring weights: regulatory_severity * 4 + customer_tier * 3 + data_sensitivity * 5 + engineering_effort_inverse * 2 + compliance_deadline_proximity * 4. Tunable via admin UI.
- Document mapping from triage category to owners: Support -> Solutions Engineering -> Legal/Compliance -> Eng-runtime.
- Create a canned checklist for SE-run remediation plans and for Eng-run retention/export workstreams.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: pilot with 3 enterprise customers and SE team (2 weeks). Phase 2: instrument triage scoring and dashboard in Console for all enterprise customers (4 weeks). Phase 3: iterate on thresholds and integrate into SLA routing for Dedicated/Private tiers (2 weeks).
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Misclassification of requests leads to delayed regulatory responses. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds that escalate ambiguous items to human review.
Risk: Intake form missing critical artifacts (legal notices, sample logs). Mitigation: require minimal proof of claim for high-severity categories and add validation hooks in form.
Risk: Engineering bandwidth spikes for retention/export work. Mitigation: temporary SE-managed remediation playbook and carveout engineering on-call for critical tickets.
Risk: Security exposure when handling exported logs. Mitigation: enforce encrypted export carriers, scoped short-lived credentials, and audit trail generation.
Risk: Conflicting customer requests across tenants. Mitigation: include cross-tenant impact analysis as part of intake and require legal signoff for global changes.
